_law: test/ui-frame-references/README.md — these floors are MEASURED rest variance, never a knob turned to make an unknown change pass.
_samples: A calibrated surface carries TWO independent rest-variance samples per frame (pass A vs B and pass A vs C of the same capture run); measuredMaxRestVariance is the worst frame of that surface across both.
_pinned: A pinned surface keeps the floor it was measured at, but a pin belongs to the GROUND it was measured over: the five floors pinned on 2026-08-20 were measured with the live 3D picture behind the interface. A reference frame now photographs the interface over a flat neutral ground, so those pins lapse at the next calibration and are re-measured. A lapse can only ever tighten a floor; nothing here widens one.
